data.name: Happy Hour (Zero Hangover, All Glutes)
data.headline: Happy hour, but the only thing on tap is a trainer.
data.benefit: Happy hour, but the only thing on tap is a trainer. Book a private between 12 and 4 and get 20% off — plus a free virtual session for every two you book.
data.rationale: Privates are 6.2% of Kwality's revenue (₹20.1L in 12 months) but only ₹31k at Bandra — the biggest product gap in the portfolio. Quiet-hour pricing uses capacity that is otherwise unpaid.
data.audience: Members and newcomers buying private sessions.
data.kpi: Privates booked 12–4 pm; Bandra privates revenue (target ₹1.5L in June).

data.name: Private Practice
data.headline: Ten sessions. One trainer who knows your knees better than your physio.
data.benefit: Ten sessions. One trainer who knows your knees better than your physio. 25% off when you go big on privates.
data.rationale: Bulk private purchase is one of the allowed 25% cases. Kwality's PR1V@TE10 code (39 uses) shows demand; a pack converts one-off buyers into a 6-month relationship.
data.audience: Members and newcomers buying private sessions.

data.name: Shy Girl Starter Pack
data.headline: Not a front-row person yet? Start with a private.
data.benefit: Not a front-row person yet? Start with a 30-minute private, then join a class with a trainer who already knows your name. ₹999 of it comes off your first month.
data.rationale: Half of CRM leads never trial (Bandra 1,114 of 2,317; Kenkere 2,053 of 3,217). A private first visit removes the intimidation barrier. No historical data on private-first conversion — this is a test.
data.conditions: Effective 20% on conversion. Test at 2 studios before scaling.
data.kpi: Packs sold to 'Not Tried' leads; private-first → member (target 40%).

scenes.narration: Renewals: Auto-Reply: Out of Office, Still Squatting. Auto-reply: I'm on vacation, but my membership isn't lapsing. 7 buyers at 42,210 rupees — 2.95 lakh rupees. 8 per cent off.

data.name: Auto-Reply: Out of Office, Still Squatting
data.headline: Auto-reply: I'm on vacation, but my membership isn't lapsing.
data.benefit: Auto-reply: I'm on vacation, but my membership isn't lapsing. 3 months with unlimited freezes and 2 virtual privates for the road. We'll be here when you land.
data.rationale: Travel is the main reason members lapse in June–July. Flexibility removes the reason; list price protects the ticket. Virtual privates cost trainer time only.
data.audience: No price discount; ≈9% value from virtual privates
data.conditions: No price discount; ≈9% value from virtual privates.

steps.label: W1
steps.text: Set up Happy Hour (Zero Hangover, All Glutes) in Momence (2027-06-01 to 2027-06-30): Privates booked in quiet hours (Mon–Fri 12–4 pm, Sat 1–4 pm): 20% off a single private (Mumbai ₹4,200 vs ₹5,250; Kenkere 20% off list) and a free 30-min virtual private with every 2 in-studio privates booked in June.

steps.label: W2
steps.text: Weekly check: Happy Hour (Zero Hangover, All Glutes): Privates booked 12–4 pm; Bandra privates revenue (target ₹1.5L in June). | Private Practice: Packs sold; trainer utilisation. | Auto-Reply: Out of Office, Still Squatting: 1M → 3M upgrades; June–July lapse rate vs 2026. | Shy Girl Starter Pack: Packs sold to 'Not Tried' leads; private-first → member (target 40%).

steps.label: W3
steps.text: Mid-month review against ₹10.5L: by the 15th aim for ~half of 53 new buyers (283 first visits), 36 renewals and 7 winbacks. Push the lists, not a deeper discount.

steps.label: W4
steps.text: Close June: tag every redemption by offer ID (O27-xx), log trial attendance and trial→purchase per offer, brief next month.
